# 任务树 fixture：自环 + 重复定义（两种都要 warn）
# 本文件不含任何游戏素材。

zz_bad_missions = {
	slot = 2

	# ① 自环：required_missions 引用自身 → warn
	zz_mission_selfloop = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_mission_selfloop }
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 1 }
	}

	# ② 重复定义：这个名字会在下方再定义一次 → warn（后者覆盖前者）
	zz_mission_dup = {
		icon = mission_generic
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 10 }
	}
}

zz_bad_missions_2 = {
	slot = 3

	zz_mission_dup = {
		icon = mission_generic
		trigger = { always = yes }
		effect = { add_prestige = 20 }
	}
}
